verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs describe employee onboarding that requires the employee to configure federal and state tax information (W-4-equivalent), and the platform offers pre-built UI flows partners can launch. However, nothing shows an ops user sending a new hire a self-serve onboarding link, I-9 collection, or employee bank or direct-deposit capture; direct deposit is documented only for contractors. Missing for 10: self-serve new-hire invite flow sent before day one, I-9 collection, employee bank account/direct deposit capture in onboarding, independent or hands-on corroboration.
